verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official LangGraph CLI, but only for building and running the Agent Server locally (`langgraph dev`, `langgraph up`). No evidence shows a one-command scaffold or template for creating a new agent project, so the CLI is an adjacent feature rather than the story's capability. A project-scaffolding CLI is a fair ask for an agent framework, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command

citations.quote: LangGraph CLI is a command-line tool for building and running the Agent Server locally.
